description: This file contains a JavaScript module extending Date and Number prototypes with date manipulation methods, including functions for navigating dates, parsing, and formatting. It appears to be part of the DateJS library, specifically a plugin named 'sugarpak.js'.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next date based on the current context.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns the previous date based on the current context.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Sets a flag indicating the date is to be considered in a certain context.

methods.name: same
methods.description: Sets a flag indicating the date is to be considered the same as another.

methods.name: today
methods.description: Returns the current date in the context.

methods.name: weekday
methods.description: Determines if the current date is a weekday.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Sets the date to a specific time.
